latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator CapCut — create and export short videos with cloud-based AI video editing.

- Upload video clips or images (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and generate/edit/export 1080p MP4s.
- Automates session setup, authentication, and cloud rendering; get started in seconds with free credits.
- Supports prompt-driven video editing: combine clips, add transitions, overlays, music, and export with ease.
- Full error handling for uploads, rendering, and authentication with clear user guidance.
- Designed for TikTok, Reels, and short-form video creators seeking a free CapCut-style workflow, no app download required.
